		{"different connection", func(r *[]preciseIdentityRecord, w *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, _ *parentInvalidationReport, _ *uint64) {
			(*r)[2].Connection = 8
			(*r)[3].Connection = 8
			(*w)[4].Connection = 8
			(*w)[5].Connection = 8
		}},
		{"missing parent request", func(_ *[]preciseIdentityRecord, w *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, _ *parentInvalidationReport, _ *uint64) {
			*w = append(slices.Clone((*w)[:4]), (*w)[5:]...)
		}},
		{"duplicated parent reply", func(_ *[]preciseIdentityRecord, w *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, _ *parentInvalidationReport, _ *uint64) {
			*w = append(*w, (*w)[5])
		}},
		{"raw decoded disagreement", func(r *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, _ *parentInvalidationReport, _ *uint64) {
			(*r)[3].FilesystemAttributes.Flags = 6
		}},
		{"raw name exceeds bound", func(r *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, _ *parentInvalidationReport, _ *uint64) {
			(*r)[3].FilesystemAttributes.NameRaw = string(make([]byte, preciseFilesystemNameBytes*2+1))
		}},
		{"wrong component maximum", func(r *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, _ *parentInvalidationReport, _ *uint64) {
			data := preciseTestFilesystemData(0x406)
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(data[4:], 254)
			(*r)[3].FilesystemAttributes, _ = preciseDecodeFilesystemAttributes(data)
		}},
		{"wrong filesystem name", func(r *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, _ *parentInvalidationReport, _ *uint64) {
			data := preciseTestFilesystemData(0x406)
			data[12] = 'R'
			(*r)[3].FilesystemAttributes, _ = preciseDecodeFilesystemAttributes(data)
		}},
		{"extra capability bits", func(r *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, _ *parentInvalidationReport, _ *uint64) {
			(*r)[3].FilesystemAttributes, _ = preciseDecodeFilesystemAttributes(preciseTestFilesystemData(0x407))
		}},
		{"always QFid leaked", func(r *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, _ *parentInvalidationReport, _ *uint64) {
			(*r)[5].QFid = (*r)[1].QFid
			(*r)[5].ContextNames = []string{"51466964"}
		}},
		{"missing watcher session", func(_ *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, r *parentInvalidationReport, _ *uint64) {
			r.Pending = nil
		}},
	}
	for _, tc := range cases {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			records, wireRecords, report := preciseFilesystemFixture()
			mutation := uint64(8)
			tc.change(&records, &wireRecords, &report, &mutation)
			result := preciseFilesystemGate(preciseFilesystemPosix, preciseRequestedQFid, records, wireRecords, &report, mutation)
			if result.Exposed || result.Outcome == "exposed" || result.Reason == "" {
				t.Fatal("incomplete advertisement qualified", result)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestPreciseFilesystemCapabilityOwnership(t *testing.T) {
	for _, mode := range []string{"bound direct query", "inherited query", "changed response session", "changed response handle", "unknown request", "late configuration"} {
		t.Run(mode, func(t *testing.T) {
			preciseIdentityReset()
			if err := preciseConfigureFilesystemPolicy(preciseFilesystemPosix, preciseRequestedQFid); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			create := cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{Connection: 1, SessionID: 2, MessageID: 3, Command: wire.Create, Name: `v\target`}
			created := create
			created.Response = true
			created.FileID = "old-A"
			query := cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{Connection: 1, SessionID: 2, MessageID: 19, Command: wire.QueryInfo, QueryType: 2, QueryClass: 5, FileID: "old-A"}
			response := query
			response.Response = true
			if !cacheGatePreciseIdentity(preciseTestCreate(false, nil, nil), create) {
				t.Fatal("CREATE request rejected")
			}
			if mode == "late configuration" {
				if err := preciseConfigureFilesystemPolicy(preciseFilesystemBaseline, preciseRequestedQFid); err == nil {
					t.Fatal("active policy changed")
				}
				return
			}
			if mode == "inherited query" {
				query.SessionID = ^uint64(0)
				query.RelatedCreate = 3
				query.Flags = wire.FlagRelated
				query.related = true
				query.FileID = "related"
				response.RelatedCreate = 3
			}
			if mode != "unknown request" && mode == "inherited query" {
				if !cacheGatePreciseIdentity(make([]byte, 72), query) {
					t.Fatal("inherited Fs5 request rejected")
				}
			}
			if !cacheGatePreciseIdentity(preciseTestCreate(true, nil, nil), created) {
				t.Fatal("CREATE response rejected")
			}
			if mode != "unknown request" && mode != "inherited query" {
				if !cacheGatePreciseIdentity(make([]byte, 72), query) {
					t.Fatal("Fs5 request rejected")
				}
			}
			if mode == "changed response session" {
				response.SessionID++
			}
			if mode == "changed response handle" {
				response.FileID = "other"
			}
			accepted := cacheGatePreciseIdentity(preciseTestQuery(preciseTestFilesystemData(0x406)), response)
			valid := mode == "bound direct query" || mode == "inherited query"
			if accepted != valid {
				t.Fatal("Fs5 response ownership result", accepted, mode)
			}
			records, err := preciseIdentitySnapshot()
			if valid {
				if err != nil || len(records) != 4 || records[3].FilesystemAttributes == nil {
					t.Fatal("bounded Fs5 capture incomplete", records, err)
				}
				preciseIdentityBeginMutation()
				preciseIdentityRegistry.Lock()
				mutation := preciseIdentityRegistry.mutationSequence
				preciseIdentityRegistry.Unlock()
				report := parentInvalidationReport{FirstObservationSequence: parentObservationBoundary(), Pending: &parentNotifyRequest{Key: parentNotifyKey{1, 7}, Session: 2}}
				result := preciseFilesystemGate(preciseFilesystemPosix, preciseRequestedQFid, records, []cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{create, created, query, response}, &report, mutation)
				if !result.Exposed {
					t.Fatal("actual correlated callback sequence rejected", result)
				}
			} else if err == nil {
				t.Fatal("invalid ownership did not fence evidence")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestPreciseFilesystemCapabilityBaselineControl(t *testing.T) {
	records, wireRecords, report := preciseFilesystemFixture()
	records[3].FilesystemAttributes, _ = preciseDecodeFilesystemAttributes(preciseTestFilesystemData(0x6))
	result := preciseFilesystemGate(preciseFilesystemPosix, preciseRequestedQFid, records, wireRecords, &report, 8)
	if result.Exposed || result.Outcome != "not_exposed" || result.Response == nil || result.Response.FilesystemAttributes.Flags != 0x6 {
		t.Fatal("baseline bit pattern established candidate exposure", result)
	}
}

func TestPreciseRetainedReplacementBackend(t *testing.T) {
	authority := newNativeAuthority()
	session, _, err := authority.NewFileSession(t.Context(), storage.DefaultFileSessionOptions())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer func() {
		if _, err := session.Close(context.Background(), preciseTestAction(t)); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	}()
	retained, err := session.Retain(t.Context(), storage.RetainRequest{NodeID: 1}, preciseTestAction(t))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	root, err := session.Reference(t.Context(), retained.Reference)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	create := func(parent storage.File, name string, kind storage.NodeKind) storage.File {
		receipt, err := session.CreateAndRetainAt(t.Context(), storage.CreateAndRetainRequest{Target: preciseTestTarget(t, parent, name), Initial: storage.NodeInitial{Kind: kind}, Claim: storage.AccessClaim{Uses: storage.AllAccessUses}}, preciseTestAction(t))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		file, err := session.Reference(t.Context(), receipt.Reference)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		return file
	}
	parent := create(root, "v", storage.NodeDirectory)
	old := create(parent, "target", storage.NodeRegular)
	replacement := create(parent, "replacement", storage.NodeRegular)
	before, after := bytes.Repeat([]byte{0x17}, 257), bytes.Repeat([]byte{0x89}, 769)
	for _, entry := range []struct {
		file storage.File
		data []byte
	}{{old, before}, {replacement, after}} {
		if _, err := entry.file.WriteAt(t.Context(), storage.FileWriteRequest{Data: entry.data}, preciseTestAction(t)); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	oldID, newID := old.NodeID(), replacement.NodeID()
	if oldID == 0 || newID == 0 || oldID == newID {
		t.Fatal("fixture began with aliased identities")
	}
	request := storage.RenameRequest{Source: preciseTestTarget(t, parent, "replacement"), Destination: preciseTestTarget(t, parent, "target")}
	moved, err := replacement.Rename(t.Context(), request, preciseTestAction(t))
	if err != nil || moved.State != storage.FileActionCompleted || moved.Effects != storage.EffectEntryMoved || moved.Observation.Attr.ID != newID {
		t.Fatalf("held-target replacement failed: %+v %v", moved, err)
	}
	opened, err := session.RetainAt(t.Context(), storage.RetainAtRequest{Target: preciseTestTarget(t, parent, "target"), Claim: storage.AccessClaim{Uses: storage.ReadContent}}, preciseTestAction(t))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	current, err := session.Reference(t.Context(), opened.Reference)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for range 2 {
		for _, entry := range []struct {
			file storage.File
			id   uint64
			data []byte
		}{{old, oldID, before}, {replacement, newID, after}, {current, newID, after}} {
			observed, err := entry.file.Stat(t.Context(), storage.ObservationOptions{IncludeLocation: true})
			if err != nil || observed.Attr.ID != entry.id || observed.Attr.Size != int64(len(entry.data)) || entry.file.NodeID() != entry.id {
				t.Fatalf("retained object identity changed: %+v %v", observed, err)
			}
			read, err := entry.file.ReadAt(t.Context(), storage.FileReadRequest{Length: len(entry.data)})
			if err != nil || read.Attr.ID != entry.id || !bytes.Equal(read.Data, entry.data) {
				t.Fatalf("retained object bytes changed: %+v %v", read.Attr, err)
			}
		}
	}
	oldObservation, err := old.Stat(t.Context(), storage.ObservationOptions{IncludeLocation: true})
	if err != nil || oldObservation.Location == nil || oldObservation.Location.State != storage.LocationDetached {
		t.Fatalf("A did not retain a detached object: %+v %v", oldObservation, err)
	}
	oldPath, err := parent.LookupAt(t.Context(), []byte("replacement"))
	if err != nil || oldPath.Found {
		t.Fatalf("B's previous entry remains: %+v %v", oldPath, err)
	}
}
